metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.description:
Detects execution or installation activity associated with self-hosted AI agent frameworks and autonomous AI tooling (such as OpenClaw, Moltbot, Clawdbot, AutoGPT, BabyAGI, Hermes, OpenInterpreter, CrewAI, LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, and related ecosystems) on devices not explicitly approved in the Approved_AI_Agent_Runtimes watchlist.
The detection focuses on runtime and package-management behavior involving Python, NodeJS, Docker, Podman, npm, pip, and related execution frameworks to reduce false positives from simple keyword searches, administrative discovery activity, or threat-hunting commands.
properties.query:
let ApprovedDevices = union isfuzzy=true
  (_GetWatchlist('Approved_AI_Agent_Runtimes') | project DeviceName),
  (datatable(DeviceName:string)[])
| distinct DeviceName;
let SuspiciousKeywords = dynamic([
  "openclaw",
  "moltbot",
  "clawdbot",
  "autogpt",
  "babyagi",
  "hermes",
  "openinterpreter",
  "autogen",
  "crewai",
  "langchain",
  "langgraph",
  "gpt-engineer",
  "aider",
  "devika",
  "swarms"
]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where DeviceName !in (ApprovedDevices)
| where
  ProcessCommandLine has_any (SuspiciousKeywords)
  or FileName has_any (SuspiciousKeywords)
// Focus on actual runtime / installation activity/instead of grep/find/hunting activity
| where
  FileName startswith "python"
  or FileName in~ (
      "node",
      "docker",
      "podman",
      "npm",
      "pip",
      "pip3",
      "uv"
  )
| summarize 
  FirstSeen=min(Timestamp),
  LastSeen=max(Timestamp),
  EventCount=count(),
  SampleCommand=any(ProcessCommandLine),
  ParentProcess=any(InitiatingProcessFileName),
  ParentCommand=any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine)
 by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, FileName
| order by LastSeen desc
